fx._comment: Live rate source is the Frankfurter API (https://frankfurter.dev), a free, no-key service that republishes ECB reference rates. This is NOT XE.com's data feed -- XE's own API is a paid product with no free tier. Frankfurter tracks the same mid-market rate family as XE and is a reasonable free stand-in. If a paid XE subscription is added later, swap the fetch logic in fx_rate.py.

covers._comment: A separate cover/back-cover pair per pdf_type ('web' or 'print' -- see build_pricelist.py). The print pair is real InDesign exports with their own bleed + crop marks already built in (a /TrimBox smaller than /MediaBox); the web pair is either the same kind of file (bleed gets cropped back off, see print_marks.crop_to_trim) or a plain trim-size PDF.

date_stamp._comment: Position is in points from the bottom-left corner of each cover's own trim area (its /TrimBox, not necessarily the full page -- see cover_stamp.stamp_pdf_page). x=22pt (~7.8mm) matches the real covers' own left text margin (measured off the rendered PDF, not a value from the design source). font must be one of the names registered in cover_stamp.py: Inter, Inter-Medium, Inter-SemiBold, Inter-Bold (or a reportlab built-in like Helvetica). Inter-Bold at 10pt matches the weight/size of the cover templates' own nearby text (e.g. the front cover's 'IKYUM® -- Verres ophtalmiques sur mesure.' tagline).
